Material* (ShaderManager* mgr, std::string name, std::string shaderFile) — both strings by value (the callee destroys them with string_TidyDeallocate); FNV-1a map at mgr+0x278; an existing name is returned as-is (the shader file is then ignored), else the shader is loaded (0x9bb220) and a 0x88-byte Material constructed (0x9bcfc0). Materials live in the map for the process lifetime.

void (Material*, std::string name, float x (xmm2), float y (xmm3), float z (stack), float w (stack)): copies the name, SetUniform(mat, copy, &xyzw, 16), then destroys the by-value name (jmp string_TidyDeallocate).
void (Material*, std::string name, float v (xmm2)): copies the name, SetUniform(mat, copy, &v, 4), destroys the by-value name.

void (Material*, std::string name, Texture* tex, int slot): mat+0x81 = 1, (mat+0x38)[slot].tex (+8) = tex, then SetUniformInt(name, slot); destroys the by-value name. The composites bind the mask camera's texture as `framebuf` in slot 6.

Pass* (Camera*, Material*, int layer): allocates a 0xa0-byte pass (+0x10 enabled = 1, +0x14 = layer, full-screen rects at +0x18/+0x38, +0x58 flags = 1, +0x98 predicate impl = null = always enabled) with one {Material*, 1} entry and pushes it into (camera+0xb0)[layer]; layer -1 = the last one. The pass is owned by the camera (freed by Camera_dtor): never cache a Pass* across frames.

void (RenderQueue* queue, renderable, Position*, int layer, uint32 flags): appends a 0x20-byte {renderable, Position*, double sortKey, u32 flags} item to the layer's draw list (layer table queue+0x38, 0xe8 bytes per layer). Reference only: every renderer submits itself with it, once per extra layer.

void (MaskedRendererIso* this) — vftable 0x140ed81e8 slot 19 (per-frame submit): optional y-lift, Scene_SubmitDraw(this+0x38, this, this+0x40, this+0x54 layer, this+0x58 flags) and once more for every entry of the extra-layer vector +0x68 cap / +0x6c count / +0x70 data. That vector is how a unit lands in the outline mask (layer 0x18): there is no re-draw call anywhere. Witness of OFF_RND_EXTRA_COUNT / OFF_RND_EXTRA_DATA.

void (StatusMenu* this) — StatusMenu vftable 0x141120ff8 slot 11: resolves the hovered unit (TacticsGrid_GetUnitAtTile) into +0xe8, swap-removes every 0x18 from the previously outlined unit's (+0xf8, validated by the pool generation at Character-8 against +0x100) renderer extra layers, pushes 0x18 onto the new one's with vec_u32_AddUnique, then +0xf8 = +0xe8. Witness of CONST_MASK_LAYER, OFF_CH_RENDERER, OFF_RND_EXTRA_LAYERS, OFF_CH_GENERATION.

void (Camera*, double scale -> +0x88, int unit -> +0x98, byte -> +0x81): +0x80 = 1 and lazily allocates the glaiel::Texture2D at camera+0x50 (the texture the composites read as `framebuf`). Witness of OFF_CAM_RTT_TEXTURE.

the ShaderManager every material creation site loads (`mov rcx,[rip+…]` right before each GetOrCreateMaterial call in TacticsTest::init, e.g. 0x83541c before the composite_outlines call at 0x835423): the SAME object as App_global — the material map (FNV-1a, +0x278/+0x280) lives inside the ApplicationBase. mov [rbx+0x38],rcx (0x979926): the second rect (the scissor), full screen by default

entries.name: MaskLayer

anchors.note: mov dword [rbp+0x568],0x18 (0x81b249) right before the only vec_u32_AddUnique call in StatusMenu_update: the draw layer the outline mask camera (TacticsTest+0x58, mode 3 = flat white) renders — a unit whose renderer lists it is drawn into the mask

entries.note: combat draw layer 0x18: the outline mask (TacticsTest::init sets its draw mode to 3 = MovieClip_DrawFlat white)

entries.name: CompositeLayer

anchors.note: mov r8d,0x1a (0x835574) before AddPostProcessPass(mainCamera, composite_outlines, 0x1a) at 0x83558a (the jumpflood_composite pass at 0x8358c8 is the second match). Not a call-arg witness: the first AddPostProcessPass call in init is the battlefield effect at pass 0x22 (0x834b82)

entries.note: the main camera's pass index the outline composites run after (pass index == layer index)

entries.name: GlowFramebufSlot

entries.note: material texture slot of `framebuf` on the outline composites (the blur passes use the int 4 = the pass runner's input convention instead)

entries.name: VT_TacticsTest_LateRender

The glow engine checks vftable[VT_TT_LATERENDER] == the signature-resolved FW_SYM_TacticsTest_LateRender before installing its hook
